No: 新增表征列（IC50 ~ Binding Energy Se3d）含义及对细胞毒性研究的作用

Coat/Functional Group: Half Maximal Inhibitory Concentration，半数抑制浓度，是纳米材料抑制50%细胞活力所需的摩尔浓度（单位统一为µM Se浓度，但Article 2中IC50以DOX浓度计，详见Unit_Note列）。IC50越低毒性越强；结合正常细胞与癌细胞IC50可计算选择指数（SI），用于评估选择性抗癌潜力。
IC50单位补充说明列。当IC50参考物质或原文单位与列标注（µM）不一致时，在此说明转换方式。Article 1 & 3 & 4：IC50以Se浓度计（µM），无需额外说明；Article 2：IC50以DOX浓度计（原文nM，已换算为µM）。
元素组成（重量百分比），通常由EDX或XPS测定，描述纳米粒子中各元素的质量占比（如 Se 76.81%，O 23.19%）。元素组成验证材料纯度和批间一致性，是理解毒性机制的重要参数。
晶体结构/晶格条纹间距，由HR-TEM测量。可验证纳米材料的晶相。晶体结构影响化学稳定性、表面能和溶解速率，进而影响体内释放行为和毒性。
长期稳定性（周），指纳米粒子在水溶液中保持粒径和分散性不发生明显变化的持续时间。稳定性是纳米药物临床转化的核心先决条件，稳定性不达标则体外毒性数据不具可比性。
Se 3d 轨道结合能，由XPS测定（eV）。反映Se的化学价态和表面修饰状态：零价Se (Se0)约54-55 eV，亚硒酸盐(Se4+)约58-59 eV。功能化修饰会引起结合能小幅偏移，是验证表面修饰成功与否的直接证据。
流体动力学直径（水中DLS粒径）与TEM核心粒径之比，反映纳米粒子表面修饰层厚度的相对大小。Size Ratio越大，说明表面修饰层越厚，表面水化层或有机壳层对纳米粒子整体尺寸贡献越大，对细胞摄取行为和体内循环时间有重要影响。

Article_ID: Selenium Nanoparticles as a Carrier of 5-Fluorouracil to Achieve Anticancer Synergism
DOI: A simple method for preparing 5-fluorouracil surface-functionalized selenium nanoparticles (SFU-SeNPs) with enhanced anticancer activity was developed. Spherical SeNPs capped with SFU through Se−O and Se−N bonds showed enhanced cellular uptake and selective cytotoxicity against cancer cells.
Title: SFU-SeNPs were synthesized by functionalizing pre-formed SeNPs with 5-fluorouracil through chemical conjugation and physical adsorption. Material characterization included TEM, DLS, zeta potential, EDX, FTIR, and XPS. Cytotoxicity evaluated by MTT assay after 24 h exposure across multiple cell lines. Mechanistic studies included cellular uptake assays, colocalization imaging, apoptosis detection (TUNEL, caspase activity), cell cycle analysis, ROS measurement, and mitochondrial membrane potential assessment.
Abstract: SFU-SeNPs demonstrated significantly enhanced cytotoxicity compared to bare SeNPs, with IC50 values ranging from 6.2 to 14.4 µM for various human cancer cell lines. The particles induced dose-dependent apoptosis via mitochondrial pathway involving caspase-3/8/9 activation, ROS overproduction, and cell cycle arrest at sub-G1 phase. Selective toxicity toward cancer cells versus normal cells was confirmed. Synergistic interaction between SFU and Se components was validated by isobologram analysis.

Article_ID: Dual-Targeted Selenium Nanoparticles for Synergistic Photothermal Therapy and Chemotherapy of Tumors
DOI: A combination of chemo- and photothermal therapy has emerged as a promising tactic for cancer treatment. However, the inaccuracy of accurate delivery and the ability to control drug release are still challenging puzzles. Hence, to assure that the chemotherapeutic drug and photothermal agent are synergistically delivered to a tumor area for their target effect, a dual-target (RC-12 and PG-6 peptides) functionalized selenium nanoparticles loaded with both doxorubicin (DOX) and indocyanine green (ICG) were designed and successfully synthesized.
Title: SeNPs were synthesized by chemical reduction method using Na₂SeO₃ and VC. RC-12 and PG-6 targeting peptides were conjugated via amide reaction. DOX and ICG were loaded onto the nanoparticles. Characterization was performed by TEM, DLS, UV-vis spectroscopy, FTIR, and zeta potential analysis. MTT assay was used to evaluate cytotoxicity on HepG2 and L02 cells with or without NIR laser irradiation (3 W/cm²). Cellular uptake was tracked by confocal microscopy using lyso-tracker and DAPI staining.
Abstract: The cell viability of HepG2 cells decreased with increasing concentration of SeNPs-DOX-ICG-RP without NIR irradiation. The toxicity was significantly enhanced under NIR laser irradiation due to photothermal effect and accelerated drug release. Normal L02 cells showed higher viability compared to HepG2 cells under the same treatment conditions.
